phases.description: NAOMI holds HOLLIS's look, quite still

questions.question: 0-0.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - NAOMI looks at HOLLIS?
0.5-4.7s ACTION: does this happen on screen - NAOMI speaks to HOLLIS calmly?
4.7-6s HOLD: does this happen on screen - NAOMI holds HOLLIS's look, quite still?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): NAOMI speaks to HOLLIS
NAOMI: does the face/body read as composed, patient (restrained)? Must NOT read as: smugness.
Line 423 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: NAOMI: People hire lawyers for all kinds of reasons. Mostly ordinary ones.
NAOMI sounds like the voice bible: calm, even female voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC04_g04: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI seated in the waiting chair, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed on the counter, red seal up; the ledger: lying closed on the counter; the ID card: in HOLLIS's pocket.

Last frame matches state SC04_g05: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI seated in the waiting chair, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed on the counter, red seal up; the ledger: lying closed on the counter; the ID card: in HOLLIS's pocket.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Corners (all four, full size): any watermark, logo, sparkle or text? Name it and its corner. The known Gemini sparkle bottom-right is recorded, not removed (Owner decision); any other mark fails.
Line 423: does NAOMI clearly speak to HOLLIS (eyes and body toward them)?
Is the place where HOLLIS stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do NAOMI's eyes go to frame-right, well clear of the lens?
Does NAOMI look at HOLLIS and never into the lens?
Do ELI and HOLLIS stay on their own sides (frosted-glass hallway door / counter, staff side and archive shelves) the whole clip?
